lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: During the year ended March 31, 2026, two customers accounted for 34.0% of the Company’s net revenues, each represented 23.5% and 10.5%, respectively.
During the year ended March 31, 2025, two customers accounted for 31.9% of the Company’s net revenues, each represented 17.8% and 14.1%, respectively.

These sales representatives accounted for approximately 75% of the Company’s net sales for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (with the balance of Company net sales being generated via direct customer contact).
International sales accounted for approximately 5.8% and 5.7% of net sales for the fiscal years ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively.
During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, two customers accounted for 34.0 % of the Company’s net sales, each represented 23.5 % and 10.5 %, respectively.
During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, two customers accounted for 31.9 % of the Company’s net sales, each represented 17.8 % and 14.1 %, respectively.
Our actual results may differ materially from those projected in forward-looking statements, as they will depend on many factors about which we are unsure, including many factors beyond our control.
The Company utilizes a variety of raw materials and manufactured component parts, which it purchases from various suppliers.
The Company relies on this intellectual property, know-how and other proprietary information, and requires employees, consultants and suppliers to sign confidentiality agreements.
Our future success depends upon the continued service of our key management, technical, sales, finance, and other critical personnel.

The payment of dividends on our common stock will depend on earnings, financial condition and other business and economic factors affecting us at such time as our Board of Directors may consider relevant.
We are the primary source for various commercial and aerospace applications in certain parts of Asia and Europe.

Pursuant to Accounting Standards Codification (“ASC”) ASC Topic 606, “Revenue from Contracts with Customers,” revenue represents the amount received or receivable for goods and services supplied by the Company to its customers.
For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, our primary sources of liquidity came from cash flows generated by operating activities and cash reserves.
Our principal source of liquidity is cash flows generated by operating activities and cash reserves.
During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, two vendors accounted for 28.5 % of the Company’s purchases, each represented 17.8 % and 10.7 %, respectively.
During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 three vendors accounted for 34.0 % of the Company’s purchases, each represented 11.7 %, 11.2 %, and 11.1 %, respectively.
